milestone.title: raul Autopilot lane — auto-refresh policy + idle poller

intent.outcome: The focused Autopilot lane periodically refreshes its display from mp autopilot session/status APIs. Display polling may pause when unfocused without affecting the headless orchestration engine.

problem.description: Users need fresh status during long drives, but raul is not the control plane. This milestone schedules coalesced UI refreshes only; liveness, heartbeats, dispatch, and escalation remain owned by M213.

in_scope: Single-flight UI refresh scheduler with manual refresh and per-session interval.
Polling pauses while unfocused or in input mode and resumes without catch-up bursts.
Render state-change and health information returned by mp APIs.
out_of_scope: Orchestrator liveness pulses, state transition relay, and stale-state escalation, owned by M213.
Any requirement that raul remain open or focused for autopilot progress.

acceptance_criteria.description: A single-flight poller invokes session show plus autopilot status once per interval; slow calls are coalesced and never overlap. Fake-clock tests cover normal and overrun intervals.
acceptance_criteria.evidence: cargo nextest run -p raul --test autopilot_poll_intervals --no-fail-fast exit 0 (9/9 pass)

acceptance_criteria.description: Display polling pauses when Autopilot is unfocused and resumes when focused; a headless drive continues and accumulates session events while display polling is paused.
acceptance_criteria.evidence: cargo nextest run -p raul --test autopilot_poll_focus_gating --no-fail-fast exit 0 (7/7 pass)

acceptance_criteria.description: Manual `r` triggers an immediate refresh; the poll timer is reset so it does not fire again immediately. Manual `p` toggles the poll on/off; the toggle state is visible in the lane footer.
Per-session `refresh_secs` override (set via D2's override panel) is honored; the polish default (2s) applies when no override.
The poller diffs API snapshots for rendering only and emits local UI StateChanged events with sequence/revision information; it never writes session state or relays progress to the orchestrator.
All UI refresh data comes from mp autopilot APIs. A fixture proves no `herdr agent prompt` is issued by raul and orchestration outcomes are unchanged when raul is absent.

Health and heartbeat timestamps returned by `mp autopilot status` are rendered without raul generating pulses. Responsive same-state agents remain healthy; stale status is displayed but escalation remains in mp.
The M217 cutover deletes the fixed-interval Watch Poller and dead `fire_watch_tick` stub after the coalescing poller is wired; no second scheduler or legacy log-tail polling path remains.

design_decisions.choice: Use one coalescing single-flight UI refresh task gated by lane-active, input-mode, and display-pause flags; at most one CLI request is in flight.
design_decisions.rationale: A two-second fire-and-forget loop can accumulate overlapping subprocesses. Coalescing keeps the UI bounded without placing it in the control path.

design_decisions.choice: Override chain for refresh_secs: session.json `config_overrides.refresh_secs` > config.json `autopilot.refresh_secs` > built-in default (2).
design_decisions.rationale: Reuses the resolution-chain logic from B1; the override panel updates the session.json value.
